svg.text: RHS 150x100x5, 2 no., bear on the 4 corner castings only
1,100 high, SHS posts at 1.5 m, hardwood top rail
4 mm stainless cables at 90 mm (gaps under 100)
open to the sky: no canopy over the terrace (D-020)
polycarbonate on own posts + ledger over the front deck
dog-leg, 16 risers about 175, goings 250, 850 wide, handrails
3.0 kN/m2 live, 0.74 kN/m rail, wind uplift: engineer to sign
The glazed side does not brace the box: nothing bears on the
slider head or the open side's top rail (STU-03).
All steelwork bonded to the earth electrode (lightning).
Polycarbonate not found online in Kigali: fallback translucent
GRP or opal corrugated sheet (Tolirwa / Safintra, field check).
Engineer's inspection before any guest uses the roof (R26).
Roof terrace, deck canopy and stair: plan and elevation
